one_liner: Datadog offers a broad REST API with OAuth 2.0 and API key authentication for observability data.
gating_notes: API keys are self-serve. OAuth 2.0 for partners requires joining the Technology Partner Program and implementing specific OAuth flows.
oauth_details: OAuth 2.0 is required for partners building integrations on behalf of mutual customers. Authorization scopes are defined for OAuth clients.

auth_methods.quote: If your integration uses the API on behalf of mutual customers, you must implement OAuth 2.0 for Partners.
